_comment: Shared sets whose repositories are deleted, or about to be. Shipped with the
engine to every repository, so every person's sessions stop loading, cloning
and freshness-checking them, and every person's Update Vendors removes them
from the precedent.json it runs in and from an individual set's `brings`
(tools/precedent_resolve.py, deleted_sets). A set that only marks itself
`retired` is dropped only while its clone can still be read; once its
repository is gone, this list is what still says so. Public sets only: a
private set a person deletes goes in their own individual set's
precedent-source.json `deleted_sets`, which is read the same way.
Morgan, 2026-10-08 (strength: decided): if another person runs Update
Vendors, it should notice a deleted set too, as a standing rule.
